statement.text:
An automorphism φ of a group G is called a splitting automorphism of order
                         2      n−1
n if φn = 1 and xxφ xφ · · · xφ     = 1 for any x ∈ G.
    a) Is it true that the derived length of a d-generated nilpotent p-group admitting
a splitting automorphism of order pn is bounded by a function of d, p, and n? This
is true for n = 1, see Archive, 7.53.
    b) The same question for pn = 4.                                      E. I. Khukhro
